name: io.github.ballostark-wq/bifrost-kfinance-mcp
title: Bifrost K-Finance, US SEC XBRL, Web3/OFAC & ISO 20022
description: K-Customs/DART, US SEC XBRL, EVM/Solana, OFAC/LEI, DoH & ISO 20022 via x402 USDC.

tools.name: kr_free_sample_and_x402_guide
tools.description: [FREE $0.00] Instant 3-month Korea Customs export/ASP preview (HBM, transformers, K-beauty, defense) plus copy-paste x402 USDC autonomous client snippets and full endpoint catalog.

theme.description: Optional Korea export theme preview: AI_MEMORY_HBM, POWER_TRANSFORMERS, K_BEAUTY_SKINCARE, K_FOOD_RAMEN, DEFENSE_ARMORED, SHIPBUILDING_LNG

partner.description: Optional ISO 2-letter partner country code in prebuilt snapshot (US, CN, TW, VN, JP, PL)

tools.name: kr_customs_trade_snapshot
tools.description: [$0.025 USDC via x402] Korea Customs HS 2-to-10-digit monthly export/import series (up to 24M) with HSK-10 sub-item share breakdown, export ASP ($/kg) & ASP YoY%, 3M MA, and KRX exporter tickers.

theme.description: Preset export theme: AI_MEMORY_HBM, POWER_TRANSFORMERS, K_BEAUTY_SKINCARE, K_FOOD_RAMEN, DEFENSE_ARMORED, SHIPBUILDING_LNG

hs_code.description: Optional custom 2 to 10 digit Korea HS/HSK code (e.g. 854232 or 8542321010)

partner.description: ISO 2-letter partner country code (e.g. US, CN, TW, VN, JP, PL)

months.description: Number of monthly observations to return (1-24, default 12)

tools.name: kr_disclosure_radar
tools.description: [$0.06 USDC via x402] Korean corporate regulatory disclosure radar (FSS OpenDART) translating KRX filings into English alpha signals: treasury buybacks, supply contracts, 5% stake flows, and CB/rights dilution alerts.

stock_code.description: 6-digit KRX stock ticker (e.g. 005930 Samsung Electronics, 000660 SK Hynix) or ALL

headlines.description: Optional Korean filing titles to classify into English signals

tools.name: kr_catalyst_brief
tools.description: [$0.08 USDC via x402] US-to-Korea cross-border supply chain & catalyst intelligence mapping US tech/industrial tickers (NVDA, MU, TSLA, AAPL, MSFT, LLY, LMT) or themes (HBM, POWER_GRID, DEFENSE) to Tier-1 KRX suppliers and key macro/earnings catalysts.

us_ticker_or_theme.description: US ticker (NVDA, MU, TSLA, AAPL, MSFT, LLY, LMT, AVGO) or theme (HBM, POWER_GRID, DEFENSE, CDMO, EV_BATTERY, SHIPBUILDING)

include_calendar.description: Include upcoming Korea/Global macro & semiconductor catalyst calendar

tools.name: kr_macro_pulse
tools.description: [$0.05 USDC via x402] Bank of Korea (ECOS) macro & FX pulse returning live BOK base rate, USD/KRW and JPY/KRW exchange rates, KTB 3Y/10Y sovereign yields, term spread in bps, CPI, and exporter regime.

include_yield_curve.description: Include KTB 3Y/10Y yields and 10Y-3Y spread in bps

items.description: Currency pair code such as USDKRW or JPYKRW

fx_pairs.description: Requested FX pairs among USDKRW, JPYKRW, EURKRW, CNYKRW

tools.name: us_sec_xbrl_radar
tools.description: [$0.03 USDC via x402] Official US SEC EDGAR submissions, decoded Form 8-K material items (earnings, M&A, restatements), standardized US-GAAP/IFRS XBRL financials (revenue, net income, EPS, CapEx YoY), and Korea supply-chain peers.

ticker.description: US stock ticker symbol (e.g. NVDA, AAPL, MU, AVGO, MSFT, TSLA, CEG). Either ticker or cik is required.

cik.description: Optional SEC Central Index Key (1-10 digits, e.g. 0001045810 for NVIDIA) when querying directly by CIK.

items.description: SEC form code such as 8-K, 10-Q, 10-K, 20-F, or 6-K

limit.description: Maximum number of recent matched filings to return (1..20, default 8).

include_xbrl.description: Whether to extract standardized US-GAAP/IFRS XBRL financial metrics and YoY growth (default true).

tools.name: evm_token_verdict
tools.description: [$0.015 USDC via x402] Pre-swap EVM ERC-20 token risk verdict across Base (8453), Ethereum (1), and Arbitrum (42161): detects honeypot sell blocks, EIP-1967 proxies, mint/blacklist/tax bytecode selectors, Sourcify status, and DEX liquidity.

chain_id.description: EVM network chain ID: 8453 (Base Mainnet, default), 1 (Ethereum), or 42161 (Arbitrum One)

token_address.description: 0x-prefixed 40-hex ERC-20 token contract address to inspect before swapping

tools.name: evm_spender_firewall
tools.description: [$0.02 USDC via x402] Pre-signature EVM allowance and spender firewall for Base (8453), Ethereum (1), and Arbitrum (42161): audits approve/Permit2 targets and calldata for unverified drainers, unlimited grants, DELEGATECALL, and proxy traps.

chain_id.description: EVM network chain ID: 8453 (Base Mainnet, default), 1 (Ethereum), or 42161 (Arbitrum One)

spender_address.description: 0x-prefixed 40-hex target contract address requesting token approval or receiving calldata

calldata.description: Optional 0x-prefixed transaction calldata hex to inspect for unlimited approve or setApprovalForAll

tools.name: solana_token_verdict
tools.description: [$0.015 USDC via x402] Pre-swap Solana SPL and Token-2022 mint safety verdict: detects PermanentDelegate seizure hooks, TransferHook/TransferFee traps, live mint or freeze authorities, holder clusters, and DEX liquidity.

mint_address.description: Base58 Solana SPL or Token-2022 token mint address (32-44 chars) to audit before swapping

include_holders.description: Whether to query top-10 token account concentration and identical-balance bundle clusters (default true)

tools.name: counterparty_sanctions_lei_check
tools.description: [$0.025 USDC via x402] Pre-payment B2B compliance gate screening entity names and crypto wallets against US Treasury OFAC SDN plus official GLEIF Global LEI entity status, direct/ultimate parent hierarchy, and optional EU VIES VAT.

entity_name.description: Counterparty company, individual, or vessel legal name to screen against OFAC SDN and GLEIF

country_code.description: Optional 2-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. US, DE, CH, KR)

lei.description: Optional 20-character ISO 17442 Legal Entity Identifier (Mod 97-10 verified)

wallet_address.description: Optional EVM (0x...), Solana, Bitcoin, or TRON wallet address to screen against OFAC Digital Currency Addresses

eu_vat.description: Optional EU VAT number (e.g. DE123456789) for live European Commission VIES validation

tools.name: domain_email_guard
tools.description: [$0.015 USDC via x402] HTTPS DoH batch firewall (up to 10 emails/domains per call) checking MX deliverability, Null-MX, SPF/DMARC anti-spoofing policies, DNSSEC, disposable burner domains, and optional RDAP domain age.

items.description: Email address (user@domain.com) or bare domain (domain.com) to inspect

targets.description: Batch of 1 to 10 email addresses or domain names to audit in one call.

email.description: Single email address convenience input when targets array is omitted.

domain.description: Single domain convenience input when targets array is omitted.

check_domain_age.description: Optional live RDAP domain registration age check to flag <30-day newly registered phishing domains (default false).

tools.name: iso20022_generate_pain001
tools.description: [$0.04 USDC via x402] Stateless JSON-to-ISO 20022 pain.001.001.09 credit transfer XML generator with exact Decimal CtrlSum, SPS 2026 & EPC SEPA structured postal addresses, IBAN Mod-97, and BIC checks.

message_id.description: Optional Group Header MsgId (max 35 SWIFT FIN-X chars)

execution_date.description: Requested execution date in YYYY-MM-DD format

compliance_profile.description: Address rule profile: SPS_2026_AND_SEPA or EPC_SEPA_TRANSITION

debtor.description: Ordering debtor account holder details and structured postal address

bic.description: Optional Debtor agent BICFI (8 or 11 chars)

address.description: Structured or hybrid postal address with town_name and country

transactions.description: Non-empty list of credit transfer instructions with amount, currency, creditor_name, creditor_iban, and creditor_address

items.description: Single SEPA or ISO 20022 credit transfer instruction

amount.description: Positive decimal transfer amount such as 1250.50

currency.description: 3-letter ISO 4217 currency code such as EUR or CHF

creditor_address.description: Beneficiary structured or hybrid postal address

scor_reference.description: Optional ISO 11649 RF structured creditor reference

tools.name: iso20022_audit_and_parse
tools.description: [$0.03 USDC via x402] Stateless parser and compliance validator for pain.001, pacs.008, and camt.053 XML: verifies SPS 2026 structured addresses, IBAN Mod-97, Swiss QR-IBAN/QRR, SCOR, and exact CtrlSum.

xml.description: UTF-8 ISO 20022 XML string (raw XML or entity-escaped XML for pain.001, pacs.008, or camt.053)

tools.name: mt940_to_camt053_bridge
tools.description: [$0.03 USDC via x402] Stateless SWIFT MT940 bank statement parser and ISO 20022 camt.053.001.08 XML converter extracting SEPA :86: structured tags while preserving raw_narrative losslessly.

mt940.description: Raw SWIFT FIN MT940 statement string containing :20:, :25:, :60F:, :61:, :86:, and :62F: tags

tools.name: clean_context
tools.description: [$0.015 USDC via x402] High-density HTML-to-Markdown distiller that removes scripts, styles, ads, and navigation noise while preserving pipe tables, links, and token compression metrics.

html.description: Raw HTML document to distill into clean Markdown

tools.name: preflight_validate
tools.description: [$0.005 USDC via x402] Deterministic pre-flight validator for JSON payloads, required keys, 5-field POSIX cron schedules, regex ReDoS safety, ISO-8601 timestamps, and target URL SSRF/syntax checks with a signed attestation hash.

required_keys.description: Required top-level keys that must exist in json_text

regex.description: Regular expression pattern to check for syntax and ReDoS safety

iso_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp string to normalize and verify

target_url.description: HTTP or HTTPS target URL to check for SSRF safety
